task: A restaurant sells 10 tacos for $8.49, or 6 of the same kind of taco for $5.40.
Which is the better deal? Explain how you know.
response: The 10-taco offer is a better deal.
Based on the price per taco: The 10-taco offer is about $0.85 per taco because \(8.49 \div 10 = 0.849\). The 6-taco offer is $0.90 per taco because \(5.40 \div 6 = 0.90\).

Or, look at the cost of a common multiple number of tacos. The least common multiple is 30. Using the 10-taco offer, 30 tacos cost $25.47. Using the 6-taco offer, 30 tacos cost $27.00. The 10-taco offer is better.

Based on how much you get for a dollar (the calculations are more difficult with this approach): With the 10-taco offer, you get around 1.2 tacos per dollar because \(10 \div 8.49 \approx 1.2\). With the 6-taco offer, you get around 1.1 tacos per dollar because \(6 \div 5.40 \approx 1.1\).
